claims.label: Kolvet publicly disputed authenticity of text messages shared by Candace Owens
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet, in a public X post the host reads, asserted he had no idea whether the text messages shared by Candace Owens were authentic, said that for argument's sake, if real, releasing a man's private messages after his death "can be an evil thing", and said Candace was "weaponizing" Charlie's private messages.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain independent forensic verification of the disputed messages and compare against Kolvet's stated inability to confirm.

claims.label: Twitter Community Note corrected Kolvet's framing about text message timeline
claims.claim: Per a Twitter note the host reads, Kolvet previously challenged Owens to show proof of a genuine friendship from the last 12, 18 or 24 months, and the released texts are from November 2023, within 22 months of Charlie Kirk's death on September 10. The host adds that Kolvet cannot keep moving the goalpost.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm that the November 2023 date corresponds to the text messages Candace referenced in the prior episode, and confirm the Community Note remains attached to the original Kolvet post.

claims.label: Blake Neff publicly called Candace a "vile witch" in X post
claims.claim: Blake Neff, in a post the host reads, used the phrase "vile witch" directed at Candace Owens in response to her question about whether Charlie Kirk was cremated.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the original post remains accessible and document its publication time and any subsequent edits or deletions.

claims.label: Erika Kirk publicly requested "one thing" remain sacred about Charlie's burial
claims.claim: Erika Kirk, in a Fox News interview with Harris Faulkner, publicly requested that the location where Charlie Kirk is laid to rest remain a single sacred exception to the public disclosure she said applied to everything else.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the interview air date, obtain the full transcript, and verify the exact exchange against subsequent statements about a Turning Point USA memorial.

claims.label: Pastor Russell denounced named political opponents in sermon
claims.claim: In a sermon clip the host plays, Pastor Russell, preaching at Pursuit Church in a sermon connected to Erika Kirk's Make Heaven Crowded tour, says he refuses to allow the conservative movement to be taken over by "vitriolic Jew haters, white nationalist, anti-semites, or Muslim-funded ex-Fox News personalities" and says of what Charlie started, "we have the responsibility to finish."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the sermon date, obtain the full recording, and confirm the institutional affiliation between Pursuit Church and Turning Point Faith.

claims.label: Erika Kirk referenced heaven focus and eternal life during tour speech
claims.claim: Erika Kirk, in a Make Heaven Crowded tour speech, stated she was "way more heaven focused" since Charlie's murder and quoted an unnamed source as saying "eternal life begins the moment that you truly know Christ."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full event recording and verify whether the speech was read from a written or pre-prepared source.

claims.label: Erika Kirk referenced "my kids are watching me" in tour speech
claims.claim: Erika Kirk, in a Make Heaven Crowded tour speech, framed her refusal to surrender around the claim that "my kids are watching me," "my co-workers are watching me," and a "cloud of witnesses."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm against the full event recording and verify event date and venue.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet publicly denied being in Washington DC with TPUSA team
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet, in an X post, denied that he, the TPUSA in-house lawyer, or CMO Marina Minas were in Washington DC, and additionally denied a prior host claim that he had been in DC on January 29 meeting top brass and staging a pre-record with Kash Patel.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with White House visitor logs (subject to release), publicly verifiable schedules, and the host's claimed source corroboration.

claims.label: Devonte West Instagram Account Mocked Contemporary Christianese
claims.claim: Devonte West, via an Instagram video, posted content mocking contemporary Christian pastoral rhetoric and its repetition patterns, presented in the episode as a parallel commentary on Erika Kirk's tour speech style.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original Instagram post remains accessible and identify the target of the mockery if specified.

claims.label: Host asserts Dr. Deirdre Amaro has resigned as Utah Chief Medical Examiner
claims.claim: Candace Owens claims an exclusive report that Dr. Deirdre Amaro resigned from her position as Utah Chief Medical Examiner, with no official reason provided.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain primary source confirmation from the Utah Department of Health, official press release, or public records. Flag as "Artifact verbally referenced but not shown" and "Requires human verification."

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Kirk's Wedding Ring Had an Open Clasp and Was Never Recovered
claims.claim: Candace Owens states, in response to a YouTube comment, that Charlie Kirk's wedding ring had an open clasp, that the ring can be seen falling off his finger in certain footage, and that she has been told the ring was never recovered.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain and verify the underlying footage, confirm the open-clasp detail against the ring's design, and identify the source of the "never recovered" assertion.

claims.label: Host received tip alleging 911 call from Charlie's security team captured specific phrases
claims.claim: Candace Owens reports receiving a "solid tip" that a 911 call placed by Charlie's security team during transport to the hospital lasted approximately 3–5 minutes, did not result in operator engagement, and captured the phrases "We got him. We are taking him to the hospital," "Get that off of him," and "Get out of the way."
claims.investigative_direction: File records requests for the underlying 911 audio and CAD records; cross-reference against any released call logs; verify the identity of the caller and whether the call was logged as abandoned. Flag as "Artifact verbally referenced but not shown" and "Requires human verification."

claims.label: Host Says Amaro's Tenure as Utah Chief Medical Examiner Began July 1, 2024
claims.claim: The host says Dr. Deirdre Amaro became Utah's chief medical examiner on July 1, 2024, and would have signed off on Charlie Kirk's autopsy report.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the Utah Department of Health or governor's appointment record for Amaro's start date and the autopsy report's signatory.
claims.transcript_snippet: a woman by the name of Dr. Deirdre Amaro. Uh her tenure began July 1st of 2024. And now we can exclusively report that Dr. Deirdre Amaro has resigned from her position.

claims.label: Host Says Amaro Claims Descent From Leif Erikson
claims.claim: The host says Dr. Deirdre Amaro claims to be a direct descendant of Leif Erikson, which the host says may be true based on her team's research, and that Amaro has strong military ties and comes from a powerful family.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Amaro's own statement of the descent and the genealogical or military-family records the host's team relied on.
claims.transcript_snippet: claims to be a direct descendant of Leif Erikson, which actually may be true based on our research

claims.label: Host Hears of Wider Resignations at UVU and Police Departments
claims.claim: The host says she is hearing that there are a lot of resignations happening across the board, particularly at Utah Valley University and at police departments, which she says all seem to be occurring because people have a general sense of corruption they would like to remove themselves from.
claims.investigative_direction: Request UVU and Utah police department separation lists and dates; the host names no individual beyond Amaro.
claims.transcript_snippet: Now, I am actually hearing that there are a lot of resignations happening, full stop, across the board, uh particularly at UVU, also at police departments

claims.label: Host Asks for Tips on Amaro Resignation at tips@candaceowens.com
claims.claim: The host asks viewers who know more about Dr. Deirdre Amaro's sudden resignation to email tips@candaceowens.com, calling it a lead people should chase.
claims.investigative_direction: Track whether tips about the Amaro resignation are later cited by the host; a tip line is not itself evidence.
claims.transcript_snippet: If you perhaps know more, please do send us an email to tips@candaceowens. com.

claims.label: Host Says Daily Mail Article Quotes a Family Friend Saying Erika Calls Her the B-Word
claims.claim: The host says the Daily Mail article used direct quotations to assert that a family friend of Erika Kirk confirmed Erika refers to the host as the B-word in private, and that the article is still up with those quotations.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the live Daily Mail article and its edit history to confirm the quotations remain and who is attributed.
claims.transcript_snippet: wherein direct quotations were used to assert a family friend of Erika's confirmed that Erika refers to me as the B-word in private.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Explicitly Lied and Blamed Her for the Daily Mail Article
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet explicitly lied and tried to blame her for the Daily Mail article.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Kolvet's public statements on the article with the Daily Mail's own account and any comment request it sent TPUSA.
claims.transcript_snippet: Remember, Andrew Kolvet lied, explicitly lied, and attempted to blame me for that article.

claims.label: Host Says Erika and a Family Friend Planted the Daily Mail Article and It Backfired
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk and her close family friend planted the Daily Mail article, that it backfired, and that they then tried to turn the blame on the host, and that Kolvet also lied about the journalist.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the family friend and the Daily Mail reporter's sourcing; the host presents this as her inference, not a documented fact.
claims.transcript_snippet: Erika and her close family friend planted that article and then it backfired and then they tried to Darvo tactic me.

claims.label: Host Says Kanye West Tweet Was the Jet Fuel for Turning Point USA
claims.claim: The host says a tweet by Kanye West saying he loved the way Candace Owens thinks gave Turning Point USA "jet fuel" and put Charlie Kirk and her "everywhere".
claims.investigative_direction: Date the Kanye West tweet and compare TPUSA follower and event-attendance growth around it.
claims.transcript_snippet: It was actually who gave us the the jet fuel, Kanye West a tweet, I love the way Candace Owens thinks.

claims.label: Host Says She Was Turning Point USA's Communications Director
claims.claim: The host says people were asking what Turning Point USA was because she was its communications director.
claims.investigative_direction: Find TPUSA staff listings, press releases or her contract showing her title and dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: People are wondering what is Turning Point USA because I was the communications director.

claims.label: Host Reads Kolvet Post Saying Charlie Managed Her and Challenging Proof of Friendship
claims.claim: The host reads Andrew Kolvet's post during the Tyler Robinson preliminary hearing saying she and Charlie were not friends, that he managed her and kept things light and polite so she would not turn on the organization, and challenging her to show proof of friendship from the last 12, 18 and 24 months.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve Kolvet's original X post, its date and the Community Note attached to it (see C-11373).
claims.transcript_snippet: He wrote this, remember, Candace, you and Charlie were not friends. He managed you. He kept things light and polite so that you would not turn on the organization.

claims.label: Host Says the 2018 Text She Showed Related to Charlie Predicting His Own Death
claims.claim: The host says the 2018 text she previously showed was relevant to Charlie Kirk predicting his own death and was not needed to demonstrate their friendship.
claims.investigative_direction: Re-examine the 2018 text and its metadata as shown in the earlier episode.
claims.transcript_snippet: I showed a 2018 text which was relevant to him predicting his own death.

claims.label: Host Says She Toured With Charlie Every Year Under a TPUSA Contract
claims.claim: The host says she toured with Charlie Kirk every year and had a contract with Turning Point USA to do so.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the contract, tour schedules or payment records, or TPUSA's confirmation of her tour dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: I toured with him every year. I had a contract with Turning Point USA to do just that.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Initiated Messages Telling Her to Stand Up to the Jewish Mob
claims.claim: The host says the messages she shared were initiated by Charlie, in which he told her to stand up to the "Jewish mob" that was intentionally targeting her.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the host's shared screenshots with the phone data held by Erika Kirk or a forensic copy; see C-11273 for the November 15, 2023 thread.
claims.transcript_snippet: I shared messages between Charlie and I, initiated by Charlie, wherein he tells me uh to stand up to the Jewish mob, that I was being intentionally targeted by them.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Believed the Targeting Was Inorganic and Daily Wire-Backed
claims.claim: The host says Charlie told her the targeting of her was inorganic, that he knew The Daily Wire was behind it, and that he had her back publicly and privately.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the specific messages in the shared thread where Charlie names The Daily Wire and compare with Daily Wire's account.
claims.transcript_snippet: the targeting was inorganic, that he knew that The Daily Wire was behind it, that he had my back as he always did, publicly and privately.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Publicly Said He Told People to Lose His Number Over Candace
claims.claim: The host says there are public clips of Charlie saying that he told people who had something to say about Candace to lose his number.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the clips and dates of Charlie's public remarks.
claims.transcript_snippet: People have shared the clips of him saying just that publicly. He said, if you know, people are telling me to get rid to I told them to lose my number if they have anything to say about Candace.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Was Pressured by Pro-Israel Donors Over Friends and Invitees in His Last 18 Months
claims.claim: The host says that in the last year and a half of his life Charlie Kirk was swarmed by "Zionist bees" who pressured him on who he could be friends with and invite to events, using money (taking it away or giving more) as the threat.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek donor correspondence, event invitation lists and TPUSA donor records for 2024-2025; the host names no donors in this passage.
claims.transcript_snippet: the last year and a half of his life he was being swarmed by these Zionist bees who were pressuring him more and more, trying to dictate who he could be friends with

claims.label: Host Says Erika Has Charlie's Phone and Can Confirm the Shared Messages
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk has Charlie's phone and could scroll up and type in the phrase the host shared to confirm the conversation is real, and says Kolvet knows it is a real conversation.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish the custody of Charlie Kirk's phone and whether TPUSA or Erika has verified or denied the messages.
claims.transcript_snippet: Erika has his phone. Scroll up, type in the phrase that I shared, and come back with something more honest than this, okay?

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Cited Her July 2025 Clip About a Trump Call as Why Charlie Was Upset
claims.claim: The host says Kolvet shared a clip of her from July 2025, in which she revealed a phone call from Donald Trump about Brigitte Macron, and wrote that Charlie was particularly upset in July when she violated Trump's confidentiality.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve Kolvet's post and the July 2025 clip, and compare any independent account of Charlie's reaction.
claims.transcript_snippet: He then shares a clip of me from July of 2025 when I revealed my phone call to Trump and he says, Charlie was particularly upset in July when Candace violated Trump's confidentiality

claims.label: Host Concedes Charlie Probably Disliked Her Trump Disclosure but Says Their Approaches Differed
claims.claim: The host says it is probably true that Charlie disliked her sharing the Trump call, because Charlie and she took totally different approaches to politicians, with Charlie acting as a diplomat.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for contemporaneous messages or witnesses on Charlie's reaction in July 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: By the way, that's probably true. Charlie and I had a totally different approach when it came to politicians.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Called Them Friends on Stage in August 2025 and Refused to Be Morally Blackmailed
claims.claim: The host says that after July 2025 Charlie was back on stage referring to them as friends and saying in August that he would not be morally blackmailed against their friendship.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the August 2025 event video and transcript where Charlie makes the remark.
claims.transcript_snippet: he was back on stage referring to us as friends and saying that he would not be morally blackmailed against our friendship in August.

claims.label: Host Says She Posted the Cremation Question Without Saying Whether She Knows the Answer
claims.claim: The host says she dropped a simple yes-or-no question online about whether Charlie Kirk was cremated, which she may or may not know the answer to.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the burial or cremation record, death certificate disposition field or funeral home confirmation.
claims.transcript_snippet: a simple yes or no question which I I or may not know the answer to as to whether or not Charlie Kirk was cremated. I just sort of dropped that on the net.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie's Body in a Casket Was Made Public Within 24 Hours
claims.claim: The host says Charlie's dead body in a casket was made the public's business less than 24 hours after he was murdered, and says she has never seen the inside of a casket shown publicly like this.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify who filmed and released the casket footage, when, and with whose permission.
claims.transcript_snippet: I actually remember when Charlie's dead body in a casket less than 24 hours after he was murdered was in fact made the public's business.

claims.label: Host Asks Viewers to Consider the Camera Distance to Erika at the Casket
claims.claim: The host asks viewers to consider the distance of the camera to Erika Kirk as she says goodbye to her husband in the clip played on air.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the videographer and the venue of the farewell footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: I want you to think about the distance of the camera to Erika as she's saying goodbye to her husband.

claims.label: Host Says Blood on Charlie's Microphone Was Used to Fundraise at Mar-a-Lago
claims.claim: The host says the blood on Charlie's handheld microphone after the murder was used to fundraise at Mar-a-Lago, and shows Erika next to the bloody microphone.
claims.investigative_direction: Match the displayed photos to the Mar-a-Lago event and trace custody of the microphone; see C-9750.
claims.transcript_snippet: I'm also old enough to remember when the blood on Charlie's handheld microphone after he was murdered was used to fundraise at Mar-a-Lago.

claims.label: Host Thinks a Painting Shown Beside the Bloody Mic May Have Been Auctioned
claims.claim: The host says she thinks, but is not positive, that the painting shown beside the bloody microphone was auctioned.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the painting and any auction listing or results.
claims.transcript_snippet: And I I think they may have even auctioned that painting. I'm not positive, but I think they did.

claims.label: Host Says the Tent Where Charlie Was Killed Was Recreated and Opened for Selfies
claims.claim: The host says the tent under which Charlie was murdered was recreated and opened for selfie business.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the event where a replica tent was shown and who organized it.
claims.transcript_snippet: I remember, old enough to remember, when the tent under which he was murdered was recreated and opened for selfie business.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Posted Her Frail Mother in a Wheelchair on Instagram the Day Before Charlie Died
claims.claim: The host says that a day before Charlie died, Erika Kirk posted on Instagram a picture of her mother looking frail and sick in a wheelchair.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the Instagram post, its timestamp and caption.
claims.transcript_snippet: a day before Charlie died, when Erika posted her mother looking frail and sick in a wheelchair on Instagram.

claims.label: Host Says Harris Faulkner Set Erika Up With the Burial Question on Fox News
